## D2-02 · A CHECK that checks nothing

> **GENERATED · written for this system (reinforces a concept from the source)**  
> Source: [lecture2 L1280-1287](../sources/lecture2.txt) *“I could say check that type is in some list of values.”*

| Topic / concepts | Difficulty | Skills | Dataset | Task type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C2.7 | ★★★ |  | `empty database` | change the database |

This swipes table should accept exactly 'enter', 'exit' and 'deposit'. Valid 'exit' and 'deposit' swipes are rejected. Fix the CHECK.

<details><summary>Setup</summary>

```sql
CREATE TABLE "cards" ("id" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY("id"));
INSERT INTO "cards" VALUES (1);
```
</details>

```sql
CREATE TABLE "swipes" (
    "id" INTEGER,
    "card_id" INTEGER,
    "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("type" = 'enter' OR 'exit' OR 'deposit'),
    PRIMARY KEY("id"),
    FOREIGN KEY("card_id") REFERENCES "cards"("id")
);
```

<details><summary>Bug type</summary>

`logic`
</details>

Hints → [`hints/M2.md`](../hints/M2.md#d2-02) · Fix → [`solutions/M2.md`](../solutions/M2.md#d2-02)

## D2-03 · A foreign key that allows "no card"

> **GENERATED · written for this system (reinforces a concept from the source)**  
> Source: [lecture2 L968-978](../sources/lecture2.txt) *“This would be in this case, redundant.”*

| Topic / concepts | Difficulty | Skills | Dataset | Task type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C2.6, C2.7 | ★★★ |  | `empty database` | change the database |

Every swipe must belong to a real card. This table still accepts a swipe whose `card_id` is NULL. Fix the design.

<details><summary>Setup</summary>

```sql
CREATE TABLE "cards" ("id" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY("id"));
INSERT INTO "cards" VALUES (1);
```
</details>

```sql
CREATE TABLE "swipes" (
    "id" INTEGER,
    "card_id" INTEGER,
    "amount" NUMERIC NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY("id"),
    FOREIGN KEY("card_id") REFERENCES "cards"("id")
);
```

<details><summary>Bug type</summary>

`design`
</details>

Hints → [`hints/M2.md`](../hints/M2.md#d2-03) · Fix → [`solutions/M2.md`](../solutions/M2.md#d2-03)

## D2-04 · A primary key that forbids repeat visits

|---|---|---|---|---|
| C2.6 | ★★ |  | `empty database` | change the database |

Riders must be able to visit the same station many times, but the second visit is rejected. Fix the table.

```sql
CREATE TABLE "visits" (
    "rider_id" INTEGER,
    "station_id" INTEGER,
```
